title: Thai-Style Grilled Duck Salad
description: A flavorful salad featuring grilled duck breast, mixed greens, and a tangy Thai-inspired dressing.
instructions: 2. Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the duck for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
4. Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
5. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced duck, hot sauce, and salad yum wuns.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the mustardy vinaigrette and a pinch of salt and pepper.
7. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro and sliced red onion.
